title: WATERFRONT PICKUP
offer: I’m Jules. We’ve got a court, a pickup field and friendly sparring. Say tennis, soccer or boxing. You can ask how a game works, watch, practice, or leave whenever you want.

tennis.label: Tennis
tennis.description: First to 3 points. Move with WASD or the stick, then time Space / SWING as the ball reaches you. Hold left or right while swinging to place the shot. Q / LOB gives it more height.

soccer.label: Pickup soccer
soccer.description: A small pickup game with teammates and opponents. Move into space, pass and shoot. The briefing shows the controls before kickoff.

boxing.label: Friendly boxing
boxing.description: A scored sparring session. Use distance, readable punches, guard and dodges. This is friendly practice; leaving never costs anything.
